title: Parking Permit Clip V3
author: monkynozzle
description:
## 📌 EasyPark/Ford/VW Windshield Clip V3 – Reinforced Clip for the Windshield

This V3 version of my popular windshield clip offers the ultimate solution for anyone wanting to securely and neatly display their EasyPark tag or traditional parking tickets – whether for Ford, VW, or any other vehicle!

🔧 **Features:**

✅ **Wire reinforcement:** Extremely stable thanks to 0.8 mm wire (paperclip or welding wire), even at high temperatures.

✅ **Automatic print pause:** Your printer pauses; you can insert the wire at your leisure and then continue printing.

✅ **Customizable design:** Choose your logo: Ford, VW, or EasyPark – perfectly matched to your vehicle.

✅ **Flexible placement:** Versions for the driver's or passenger's side ensure optimal positioning on your windshield.

✅ **Multifunctional:** Parking tickets or other notices can be easily clipped in, should the app fail.

🛠 **Installation:**

Simply attach to the inside of the windshield using double-sided 3M adhesive tape – ideal below the rearview mirror or next to the environmental sticker. Holds firmly, even in summer.

📏 **Recommended wire:**

0.8 mm diameter – standard paperclip or welding wire.

🏆 **Why V3?**

With its reinforced construction, refined design, and flexible placement options, this clip represents a significant upgrade over V2 – combining security with a clean, elegant look suitable for any car.

🔗 **Use:**

Whether for parking enforcement officers or parking inspections – your notice always remains clearly visible, allowing you to park without worry in the urban jungle! 🐒🌴
